ai-draft.title: Written by this project's AI assistant
ai-draft.attribution: AI-assisted draft written from general knowledge. Not compared with any dictionary and not checked by a person.
ai-draft.usage: Everything with this source is unreviewed until a Mandarin teacher or other qualified person reviews it.

CC-CEDICT.title: CC-CEDICT, a community-maintained Chinese-English dictionary (distributed by MDBG)
CC-CEDICT.attribution: CC-CEDICT, https://cc-cedict.org, hosted by MDBG (https://www.mdbg.net). Entries copied or closely adapted from it must keep this attribution and the ShareAlike terms.
CC-CEDICT.usage: Guide for dictionary meanings and readings. Dictionary glosses are not automatically good answer buttons or classroom-ready: check sense, register and natural English before use.

HSK.title: Official HSK materials (specify the exact syllabus edition)
HSK.attribution: Used only as a guide to which beginner words to teach. Word lists are not copied.
HSK.usage: Distinguish the 2021 proficiency standards from the HSK syllabus published in 2025; do not infer levels.

Tatoeba.title: Tatoeba, a collection of sentences and translations
Tatoeba.license: CC BY 2.0 FR (some sentences CC0: check each sentence)
Tatoeba.attribution: Sentence author and Tatoeba sentence number, e.g. "sentence 1234567 by <author>".
Tatoeba.usage: Community sentences: each one must be reviewed individually for correctness, naturalness and level before use.

HH-editorial-2026.title: Hanzi Hunters beginner-100 editorial draft, 2026-11-01
HH-editorial-2026.attribution: AI-assisted editorial adaptation prepared for Hanzi Hunters. Dictionary senses and readings checked against CC-CEDICT. Original examples and sequence are not human-reviewed.
HH-editorial-2026.usage: Do not describe the material as teacher-approved. Retain source references and identify modifications.

HSK-2025.title: Official HSK syllabus, published November 2025, effective July 2026
HSK-2025.license: Official reference; full syllabus not redistributed
HSK-2025.attribution: Center for Language Education and Cooperation; official syllabus linked by Chinese Testing International.
HSK-2025.usage: Individual factual level/page references only. Distinct from the 2021 proficiency standards and older HSK editions.

accc-anki.title: A Course in Contemporary Chinese (當代中文課程) B1–B6, Traditional: vocabulary Anki deck shared on AnkiWeb
accc-anki.attribution: Vocabulary and recordings from A Course in Contemporary Chinese (當代中文課程), National Taiwan Normal University Mandarin Training Center, as packaged in the shared Anki deck "A_Course_in_Contemporary_Chinese__B1-B6_Traditional.apkg" (AnkiWeb 1466478713).
accc-anki.usage: Imported into the source layer (public/sources/accc-anki) for comparison. Nothing from it is playable until a person maps and selects it. Its pinyin and recordings follow the textbook's standard, which can differ from the game's dictionary readings.
accc-anki.reuse: Unknown: the deck page states no license, and the textbook material is copyrighted. The project owner decided on 2026-11-02 to include the recordings in this repository; no permission from the rights holder is documented here.
accc-anki.variety: Taiwan Mandarin (the textbook's own standard; not stated per recording)
